concepts.def: IBDP Music final assessment for performance includes solo/ensemble recording, programme notes and reflective commentary linking to inquiry areas.
Historically informed performance (HIP) Nikolaus Harnoncourt 1953 Concentus Musicus Wien revived Baroque techniques.
Curatorial decisions about repertoire order; Joseph Joachim's chronological format in Berlin 1864 influenced modern recitals.
Visual, gestural and ritual elements; Glenn Gould's elimination of live concerts 1964 highlighted recording vs concert distinction.
Intonation, dynamic balance, articulation, vibrato control; assessed against stylistic criteria for chosen contexts.
Christopher Small's Musicking 1998 reframed performance as a relational social act including listeners.
